description: A large dark-lacquered horse-drawn coach with a luggage roof and lit lanterns stands on wet cobbles in fog at dusk. Two dark horses are harnessed at the front. Passengers in top hats and bonnets sit inside its windows, and a few more stand at the open rear door. A conductor in a long coat and top hat points at the door, and a woman in a shawl and bonnet waits on the step. Old-style buildings, gas lamps and another carriage fill the background.
